infographic.title: How a Filled Temperature Switch Trips
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how a filled bulb temperature switch turns a temperature rise into a contact change
steps: Process heat raises the pressure of the fill inside the bulb.
The pressure travels through a fine capillary to the switch housing.
A membrane or diaphragm expands against the range spring.
At the setpoint a snap action switch changes over its contacts.
